arguments.sql:
SELECT u.Location, MIN(b.Date) AS earliest, MAX(b.Date) AS latest
FROM users AS u
JOIN badges AS b ON b.UserId = u.Id
WHERE b.Name = 'Organizer' AND u.Location LIKE '%Germany%'
GROUP BY u.Location
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 5

arguments.sql:
WITH organizers AS (
    SELECT b.UserId, MIN(b.Date) AS organizer_date
    FROM badges AS b
    JOIN users AS u ON u.Id = b.UserId
    WHERE b.Name = 'Organizer'
      AND u.Location LIKE '%Germany%'
    GROUP BY b.UserId
),
qualified_users AS (
    SELECT o.UserId
    FROM organizers AS o
    JOIN badges AS prior ON prior.UserId = o.UserId
                        AND prior.Date < o.organizer_date
    GROUP BY o.UserId
    HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS user_count
FROM qualified_users;
